description: February 15 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 15 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: The February 15 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: The 15th reduces to 6, numerology's household number, which can seem an odd fit for independent Aquarius. Around twenty-six degrees into the sign, with Venus sub-ruling the decan, the blend often makes sense as chosen family: someone who builds warm, unusual households and treats friends with the devotion others reserve for relatives.

Astronomically, February 15 puts the Sun near 26° Aquarius in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 15
paragraphs: Born on the 15th, the compound 1 + 5 reduces to 6, so the birthday number is 6. Here the 1's self-reliance and the 5's curiosity pour into the 6's caring, responsible nature. People with this birthday are often described as warm, magnetic and generous, with an adventurous side that keeps their care from becoming heavy. They may be drawn to roles where they look after others while still having room to move, such as teaching, hosting or creative work for families. As a supporting influence, the 15th tends to show in a lively, affectionate presence.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 15 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 15 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 15 is the 46th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Pisces, is usually complete within 4 days, by February 19.

Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 15 in 105 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it. Among the best-known people with a February 15 birthday are Louis XV of France (1710), Alfred North Whitehead (1861) and Susan B. Anthony (1820).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 15?
faq.answer: February 15 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 15?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 15 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 15th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 15?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, February 15 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 105 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 15?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 15 include Louis XV of France (1710), Alfred North Whitehead (1861) and Susan B. Anthony (1820). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
